ModMetaData.name: MooGirl Race
ModMetaData.author: PCR、114、梓磐谷客、伊贝森
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Mugirl species.
Mugirls are a slave race designed through genetic engineering by a spacefaring megacorporation for colonial labor. They combine a humanlike appearance with the strength and endurance of bovine gene stock, allowing them to handle demanding work across many colony environments. They are tough, strong, and naturally suited to planting, construction, crafting, and other physical labor. However, they are slower in intellectual work and are especially poor at medicine and research. They are reliable colony laborers, but also sympathetic products of corporate genetic design.
